name: Angelo D'Angelas
source:
Angelo is one of the lead characters in Seraphina's graphic novel. He speaks rather highly of himself and tries desperately to keep his life a mystery. He's an all-powerful wizard, or so he says, who offers his abilities to help Seraphina escape in exchange for her help to put an end to his exile.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
